name: Message in a Bottle
summary: Having answered an ocean-borne plea, you find Princess Poobah chained as a captive on an isolated island off the Stranglethorn coast. The monstrous ape King Mukla commands the local beasts and keeps her bound, requiring his defeat to secure the key to her shackle.

sections.title: A Captive on the Isle
sections.body: Following the message in the bottle brings you directly to Princess Poobah, who is held against her will by a heavy chain. The great Skymane gorilla known as King Mukla commands the creatures roaming the island and oversees her imprisonment. Poobah places her faith in you to face this formidable ape and retrieve the key needed to sever her bonds.

sections.title: The Beast to the Southeast
sections.body: Poobah notes that her captor can often be heard prowling around the southeastern side of the island. Confronting King Mukla is no small feat, but taking him down is the only way to claim the shackle key and secure Poobah's release.

sections.title: Deliverance and Gratitude
sections.body: Bringing the shackle key back frees Princess Poobah from captivity and saves her from what she considers a deep dishonor. Though she lacks the power to grant you full induction into her tribe, she offers you a token of thanks for your courage.

faq.answer: Princess Poobah is a tribal captive found chained on an island off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. After sending out a plea in a bottle, she waits for someone daring enough to overcome her captor and unlock her shackle.
She is held captive by King Mukla, a massive Skymane gorilla who holds sway over the surrounding beasts on the island.
Princess Poobah states that King Mukla can frequently be heard wandering across the southeastern side of the island.

faq.q: What is needed to free Princess Poobah?
faq.answer: You need to defeat King Mukla and find the key to her shackle, then bring it back to unlock the chain binding her.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the story?
faq.answer: This follows the original plea found in a bottle, serving as the direct confrontation against King Mukla to deliver Princess Poobah from her chains.
